listings.description: Fixed 2 Move is pleased to host a wonderful estate sale event in Exton, PA, offering a diverse array of vintage goods, workshop equipment, and outdoor living items. Highlighted offerings include vintage Lionel model train components, featuring a red lithographed tinplate gondola car, a Lionel Lines black coal tender, and track accessories. Featured equipment includes two vintage blue 10-speed road bikes—highlighted by a Panasonic Sport 500 model—alongside a rustic wooden workbench, heavy-duty post hole digger, and vintage Craftsman metal toolboxes complete with hand tools and hardware. The outdoor selection boasts a variety of patio seating, including white metal lawn chairs with yellow woven straps, wrought iron grid armchairs, stackable mesh loungers, and a glass-top patio table frame, plus a white top-freezer refrigerator, antique wooden steamer trunk, and a classic Coleman cooler. We invite you to explore this extensive collection in Exton. Payment is fast and secure, with cash, venmo, cashapp, and all major credit cards accepted on-site. Please plan to bring adequate transportation and assistance for hauling large furniture, workshop equipment, and appliances.

listings.title: Moorestown Estate Sale: 1972 Williams Pinball, Vintage Toys, Mid-Century & Retro Finds
listings.description: B&B Estate Sales is pleased to present a wonderful estate sale in Moorestown, New Jersey, featuring an eclectic mix of vintage collectibles, mid-century furniture, and nostalgic retro items. Among the highlights of this sale is a highly sought-after 1972 Williams "Spanish Eyes" pinball machine, boasting vibrant, psychedelic graphics on both the backglass and cabinet. Collectors will also find an array of vintage toys and recreational items, including an Aurora Model Motoring Real Racing slot car set in its original box, a classic Wonder Horse spring rocking horse, a vintage Welsh baby stroller, and retro plastic snowboards from Riva and Sledz. For those looking to furnish or decorate, the home offers a beautiful French Provincial style dining set with a cream-painted finish and gold trim, a set of six mid-century folding chairs with teal vinyl seats, and a classic Windsor-style armchair. Decorative highlights include a stunning Tiffany-style stained glass table lamp with a floral tulip motif, a colorful songbird stained glass window panel, and vintage holiday decor. Audiophiles and media enthusiasts will appreciate the vintage Garrard Synchro-Lab 72B turntable, a selection of classic vinyl records, and quality home audio components from Sony and Samsung. Also, vintage draft table. This sale will take place on-site in Moorestown, NJ (08057). We accept all major credit cards, Venmo, as well as cash. Please check back for final dates, times, and parking instructions. We look forward to seeing you there!
